subject: Media Literacy
title: Target Audiences
description: A quick win: understand Target Audiences.

hook.text: A beer commercial during a football game targets men 21-35. You thought it was just a funny ad.

buildup.text: Every ad is designed for a specific audience defined by age, gender, income, interests, and location.

discovery.text: Advertisers create detailed 'personas' — fictional ideal customers — and craft messages just for them.

twist.text: When you feel an ad 'speaks to you,' it was literally designed for someone with your exact profile.

climax.text: You aren't discovering products. Advertisers who studied people like you are placing products in your path.

punchline.text: The ad found you. You didn't find it.

quiz.question: What are advertising 'personas'?
options: Fictional ideal customer profiles used to craft targeted messages
